brief:
Israeli police arrested suspected drug dealers and confiscated narcotics valued at approximately 90 million shekels in a major operation, the Ma'an news agency reported. The seizure marks one of the larger drug busts conducted by Israeli authorities in recent operations targeting illegal narcotics trafficking.

Details of the specific locations, number of suspects detained, or the types of drugs recovered were not immediately available.
title: Israeli police seize drugs worth 90 million shekels
